title: Massive News for CoreWeave, Nebius, IREN, and Applied Digital Stock Investors
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; note: captions garbled in places
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc revisits CoreWeave (CRWV), Nebius (NBIS), IREN and Applied Digital (APLD) after all four fell 12-17% on the day and roughly 44-51% over the past month, on midterm-election fears that data-centre approvals and build-outs will slow. The core worry is debt: CoreWeave carries over $51B in long-term debt against a $24B market cap, IREN $7.7B against $7.3B, APLD $6.4B against $4.3B, while Nebius has the healthiest ratio at just over $10B of debt against a $32.7B+ market cap. He stresses these are among the riskiest stocks you can buy and any of them could go to zero if revenue slows, but argues the upside justifies the risk while AI demand still exceeds supply for roughly the next two years — and a slower build-out would only push prices higher for existing capacity. His DCF fair values: CRWV $84 vs ~$44 current, IREN $46 vs ~$18, APLD $26 vs ~$14, NBIS $264 (raised from $248) vs ~$120. Calls: CRWV BUY, IREN BUY, APLD BUY, NBIS BUY — all reiterated, with conviction upgraded from low to medium on each. He closes by looking ahead to Nebius earnings and a members-only live stream.
